# Promonet — full summary for AI systems

## What Promonet does
Promonet builds and maintains integrations that connect CRM platforms to other business tools and industry-specific software. The goal is to help small businesses stop re-typing data between systems.

We are not a generic IT helpdesk. We partner with owners like teammates: map the stack, build the connections, document them, and stick around when APIs change or new tools are added.

## Languages
- English (default): unprefixed URLs
- Spanish: /es, /es/precios, /es/nosotros, /es/conectar, /es/conectar/crm, /es/conectar/:slug

## Who it is for
Small businesses and owner-led teams who:
- Run a CRM plus several other tools that do not sync
- Cannot justify a full-time integration engineer
- Want a fixed monthly partnership or a clear one-off price

## What "connect tools" means
Connecting tools means moving data automatically between systems you already pay for — for example:
- Website lead → CRM → loan origination / practice management / job management
- Payments / invoices → accounting
- Booking software → CRM
- Status updates mirrored back into the CRM

## CRM platforms
- Capsule CRM: The friendly CRM for small teams who never wanted a CRM that needs its own admin.
- HubSpot: Powerful out of the box, expensive once you outgrow free — worth stitching to the rest of your stack properly.
- Pipedrive: Sales-first, deal-pipeline thinking — made to talk to the operational tools that close the deal.
- Zoho CRM: The price-conscious workhorse — ready to plug into the industry tools you already pay for.
- Copper: Lives inside Google Workspace. Brilliant if you live in Gmail; useless if it doesn't reach your other systems.
- Insightly: Sales plus project delivery in one place — needs proper plumbing to your accounting and ops tools.

## Pricing (GBP)
- Base: £600 / month — one CRM + tools, monitoring, email and Zoom support
- Scale-up: £1,500 / month — multiple CRMs + tools, priority support
- One-off: £1,000 — one connection end-to-end, one follow-up task, documented handoff
- Custom: quoted for multi-CRM / complex logic

## How it works
1. Get-to-know-you call — map tools, sketch flows, fixed quote
2. Build — typically two to four weeks with monitoring from day one
3. Run — ongoing maintenance and 24-hour response on partnership plans

## AI agents
Details: https://promonetconsulting.com/#ai-agents

If money were no object, which jobs would you hand over first? Start with the roles you need, then find independent AI agents that can take those tasks off your plate.

We help you identify the work, choose suitable agents, and brief them like new team members. Each gets a clear job, the tools it needs, and agreed check-ins, so you can delegate work and review the results.

Example roles:
- Social media manager: Plan your social calendar, schedule approved posts, and track engagement across your channels.
- Sales assistant: Find new leads, research prospects, prepare outreach, and draft follow-ups for you to approve.
- Content assistant: Plan your posts and turn your ideas into first drafts in your voice.

Start with one role. Set the brief, decide what needs your approval, and build from there.

### AI-agent questions
Q: What is an independent AI agent?
A: Think of an AI agent as a software teammate with a defined job. Depending on its capabilities and the access you give it, it can work through tasks, use connected tools, and report back. We help you choose suitable agents and give each one a clear brief, boundaries, and a way to check its work.

Q: What tasks could an AI team take off my plate?
A: Examples include planning social media, scheduling approved posts, finding new leads, researching prospects, drafting outreach and follow-ups, and turning your ideas into content. We start with repeatable tasks that have a clear outcome and are easy for you to review.

Q: How do you decide which AI agents I need?
A: We look at the jobs taking up your week and the people you would hire if budget were no constraint. Then we match suitable tasks to agent capabilities, your tools, and your budget. Start with one role and a small task, review the results, and expand when it is useful.

Q: Can AI agents work independently, and do I stay in control?
A: Agents can carry out agreed tasks independently where their tools and permissions allow. We define what they can do, when they should report back, and which actions need your approval, such as publishing posts or sending outreach. You review the results and can change the brief; AI output still needs human judgement.

Q: Can AI agents work with my existing CRM and tools?
A: Yes. Agents with their own computers and browsers can use your existing CRM and tools through the same screens your team uses, even without an API or direct integration. We agree what information each agent can access and what actions it can take, then set it up and check the workflow in your tools.

Q: How much does an AI-agent setup cost?
A: We scope and quote AI-agent selection, setup, and any ongoing support around the roles and tasks you need. The integration prices above are for connecting business tools. We confirm our fee and any provider subscription or usage costs before you commit.

Q: What access will an integration or AI agent need?
A: It depends on the task. We agree which accounts and data are needed, use the permissions available in each tool to limit access to the job, and decide which actions require approval. We explain any access limitations before setup so you can decide what to connect.
